Perkiraan margin (harga PO). Omzet = bar: Estimated margin (PO price). Revenue = invoice lines adjusted to the invoice DPP (discounts and charges in the invoice header are spread evenly across items), excluding down payment invoices. Estimated COGS = quantity in base units × purchase price per base unit from the last PO before the sale date (before PPN, after PO discounts, from all suppliers); if there is no earlier PO, the price of a later PO (flagged). Margin % only covers revenue with a known purchase price and unit; old and new item codes are not matched.
